name: The Bone Marshal

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Last Muster, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's knight (Multiattack, Parry) and wight (necrotic blade, resistances), scaled to CR 8 with legendary actions.

ac_note: plate, and the bones of his horse

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Bone Marshal fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Bone Marshal makes two Grave Blade attacks.

actions.name: Grave Blade
actions.summary: A cavalry blade swung from the saddle, cold with the grave.
actions.text: Hit: 12 (1d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.summary: Reaction: +3 AC against one melee attack that would hit him, while holding a weapon.
reactions.trigger: The Bone Marshal is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon.

options.name: Charge
options.summary: Rides at someone and makes one Grave Blade attack (the engine only strikes).

summary: The bones of the count's vanguard marshal and his warhorse, grown together over four hundred years of holding the valley's gate: a long blade cold with the grave, a parry, and a charge between your turns.
